review.official:
Nyamu Yūtenji, drummer of
Ave Mujica
. Frank and upfront, she plays an active role in supporting
Rhodes Island
's internal communications. She works with
Goldenglow
to help other operators with their makeup, a service that has earned her considerable approval.

files.description:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Nyamu Yūtenji shows no signs of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] Undisclosed
The Medical Department has agreed not to disclose the relevant data.

Nyamu Yūtenji demonstrated great curiosity about Rhodes Island the moment she set foot on the ship. Outside of work, she can often be seen studying Rhodes Island and Terra in the archives, always declining with a smile when asked if she's in need of any help. There are still many mysteries about her.

Nyamu is not just a very physically capable drummer; her bright and friendly personality has also made her many friends amongst the operators. Yet she is also highly observant, and sensitive to changes in other people's moods. By inferring what people are thinking based on their expression and body language, she is able to respond appropriately and maintain a positive atmosphere.
Everyone in the Medical Department recognizes how kind and gentle Nyamu is, though she is loath to admit it herself.

We thought it Nyamu's talent that allowed her to perform so well, both in her band and in her work at Rhodes Island.
It was only later that we learned it was not simply about talent, but the constant hard work that she puts in on her own. She is never satisfied, always pushing herself to move forward, as though the idea she could be at a standstill angers and terrifies her.
Hopefully, she will find the opportunity to slow down and take a little time off while she is on Rhodes Island.

Nyamu will spare no effort in pursuit of her dreams.
We have come to a hypothesis based on her actions and on excerpts of information from other Mujica members.
Nyamu is used to following the path that she believes to be most efficient, paying no heed to what other people think. Indeed, she could not even spare the time to think about whether she should give up or not.
In the presence of true genius, she found herself both awed and envious, and such emotions further fuel her fire.

[Iris's Notes]
Sailing for her goal in a straight line comes naturally to Nyamu, be it in dreams or reality; it is a notion she takes for granted.
It is fortunate, then, that she could rediscover the love she once abandoned.
She will not remember what transpired here when she wakes from the dream and returns to her old life, but she will continue to pursue her ideals. May a part of this dream stay with her and give her courage—
The courage to reach out to what she loves.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Ah, Doc! Say, anything need doing?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Oh, my god! If I did a vlog in here I might rake in major views, maybe? No, c'mon, obviously I'm not really!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I'm kiiiiiiinda busy right now, save it for later~

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: You ever notice how Rhodes Island is just full of all kinds of operators? Everyone's got their own goals, their own talents, it's a real show. I kinda wanna get stuck in and interview around!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Why do I volunteer for practice? Obviously you give everything you've got for your dream, right?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Whaaat? You've got more work for me? Alright, but in exchange... No, nonono, I'm kidding! If you and Amiya-chan are gonna put your trust in me like that, what am I to do but nyam-up and work my butt off!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: No way! Do you see all the cute ops here at Rhodes Island?! SO blessed! Just need to get them in a makeup vid... Ahah, I can see the views rolling in already!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: So like, a ton of the kids in Medical are fans of me now! So I'm thinking, rule no.1, gotta give the fans what they want, right?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I keep thinking lately. About reaching my goals. 'Cause doing whatever it takes, grinding away all on my own, that's been me. But hey, maybe it's nice to detour a little too, once in a while. That might be because everyone at Rhodes Island is so nice.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Huuuh. Doc fell asleep. Well, if you're asking to get pranked, who am I to say no? Nah, kidding♪

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Good morn-nyamu-nyamu! New hire Nyamuchi reporting in! Nice to meetcha♪

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Hell yeah~♪ Can't stop Nyamuchi evolving~

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: What's this? Oh, I get it, you're in with the Nyamuchi fans now?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: That's right, I've been putting in tons of work, yeah? Keep that praise coming my way, yeah?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: ...Okay.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Wait, so I'm leading? Not Sakiko?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Okay, showtime~

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Ah, enemy spotteeeed!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'm right here~

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Hmm? Need me?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: C'mere, c'mere!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I got this~

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: I'll show you what I'm really made of!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Take that!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Let's turn up the energy!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Nuh-uh-uh!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Ahahah! We make a seriously great team, huh?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Total victory! This means time for an afterparty! C'mon, let's do it!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Grrgh... Next time, I'll nail it...

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Are you gonna be a downer? 'Cause we need to think about what went wrong and why.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Oh, wow! This is a killer spot you Rhodies have got!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Nyamutto♪

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Hey, chill out, chill out~

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year! Another year of heading onward and upward for me! That's right, you too, Doc, onward and upward♪

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Nice work out there, Doc!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday~! Here you go, a present for you. Now, can I expect something nice when Nyamu's day rolls around?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Must be the Nyamuchi influence livening up Rhodes today, no doubt about it. Where's my thanks, Doc? Thank me~!
